page.overview:
Who is Seymour Brickstein?

Seymour Brickstein is a minifigure that appears in The Robot Chronicles.

He wears brown coat and hat, with Press card on it.

Seymour Brickstein is a TV reporter, reporting for City News. He always appears during the Intro of mission, speaking about situation at city. Sometimes, he also appears at illegal events, like street races. He speaks in minifigure language. Category:Agents minifigures Category:City minifigures
